svg.title: One direction, eleven places
svg.desc: Rhythms 11 / 6 have eleven places with any one left-normal direction. Gold visit 1 and lilac visit 7 share an oriented tangent line while remaining far apart. Their dots meet in a graph of normal direction and signed tangent-line distance, with different slopes. The graph edges join cyclically. Numerical illustration, not a census of shared tangents.

g.text: A shared tangent line, seen twice in direction and distance.
One line touches visits 1 and 7, 571.33 drawing units apart.
Same normal: 282.16°. Same signed distance: −67.81. Different slopes: 256.59 and -314.75.
The original drawing has equal coordinate scales. The graph uses angle and distance; its axes differ.
